title: Aggregate Two Time Series
summary: At each timestamp appearing in either sorted time series, add the two series' values. If a series lacks that timestamp, use its next later observation's value, or zero if none follows. Return sorted timestamp/sum pairs. This is forward-looking fill, not carry-forward from the past.
officialConstraints: Each series has1..100000 pairs, timestamps and values1..10^9; timestamps strictly increase within each input.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
